interview.name: Nell
interview.answer: It’s currently planned for Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Cleo is actively coordinating the repair drive and is receptive to help from others.
Nell is supportive and willing to help by watching for spare supplies.
The interaction shows a collaborative, practical relationship centered on gathering resources.
Nell is acting as a steady coordinator, keeping track of donations and relaying updates to others.
Cleo and Oren are both willing to help, with Cleo focused on gathering supplies and Oren offering practical sorting support.
Leo is actively involved in the repair drive and relies on Nell as a communication link for incoming tools and parts.
Nell is acting as a reliable information broker, repeatedly promising to pass along updates and keeping multiple people informed.
The group is coordinating around donated tools and spare parts, with several people waiting on fragments rather than complete details.
Pia stands out as needing practical logistics first, especially timing and drop-off details, so the conversation is shifting from gathering supplies to organizing delivery.
Nell is the main coordination point, repeatedly relaying updates and asking others to pass along information.
Rey, Gus, and Ira are all willing to help by watching for spare tools or supplies and forwarding what they hear.
Pia needs specific timing and drop-off details before she can plan, so she is waiting on logistics rather than inventory.
Nell is the main coordinator, relaying updates and keeping the repair drive moving.
The group is sharing responsibility in small, practical ways: Mara is handling supplies and sign-ups, while others pass along updates.
The repair drive still seems in progress, with Sunday at the community center as the current plan and only partial information circulating.

events.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive — what’s the latest on it?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering donations and tools for it, and the list is growing nicely. If you hear of any spare supplies, send them my way.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Nell: That’s good to hear — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a little scatterbrained today, but I’m happy to help if you need me.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren — I’ll do that and pass along anything I hear about donations or tools.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out too, and if I spot the bins I’ll start sorting the tools.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Nell: I’ve still only heard a few scraps, but I’m keeping an ear out for any extra supplies or tools. If I catch anything useful, I’ll pass it along right away.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell. I’m sorting the donated parts now—if you hear about any tools, just send them my way.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll keep listening and pass along anything I hear about tools or spare parts.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: I’ve only been catching fragments, so I’m still piecing it together. If you hear anything about tools or spare parts, I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — if you hear about any missing tools or spare parts, please let me know. I’ll keep an ear out too.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: I’ve only heard that the donations and tools are still coming in, and the list is growing nicely. If you hear of any spare supplies, I’ll pass them along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Pia: That sounds good — I just need the timing and drop-off spot first so I can plan properly. If you get the details, please let me know.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open for the timing and drop-off spot and let you know as soon as I hear anything.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: I’ve only heard that the donations and tools are still coming in, and the list is growing nicely. If you hear of any spare supplies, I’ll pass them along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: That’s great — I’ll keep an eye out for any spare tools or supplies and send them your way if I find any.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll keep passing along any updates I hear about the drive.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: I’m still only catching bits, so if you hear any updates on tools or spare parts, I can pass them along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — if I hear anything on tools or spare parts while I’m out, I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep listening too and pass along anything I hear.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: I’ve still only heard bits and pieces—have there been any new updates on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mara: Yes—I’ve got the clipboard and tape covered, and I can help keep track of sign-ups too. I can also sort the donated parts into keep and fix piles while you label the ones that still need attention.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Nell: That’s great, Mara — thanks for handling so much. I’ll keep an ear out for any new updates and pass them along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: Great — can you make sure everyone sees Sunday at the community center, and let me know if anything still needs sorting?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but Sunday at the community center is still the main plan. If anything else needs sorting, I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear.
events.speaker: Nell
